title: Sternly
summary: STERNLY, adverb [See Stern.] In a stern manner; with an austere or stern countenance; with an air of authority. STERNLY he pronouncd the rigid interdiction.

inlines.v: STERNLY, adverb [See Stern.] In a stern manner; with an austere or stern countenance; with an air of authority. STERNLY he pronouncd the rigid interdiction.
